title_sq: Dyqan per shitje te Rruga e Kavajes, perballe Delijorgjit
description_sq:
Dyqan ne Rr. e Kavajes - perballe Delijorgji, per shitje!
Ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara te Tiranes, Ruga e Kavajes, perballe kompleksit Delijorgji, ofrojme dyqan per shitje.
Me siperfaqe neto prej 222.1 m2, dyqani eshte i vendosur ne "corner", me fasade xhami, duke ofruar mundesi ekspozimi te larte dhe akses te lehte per klientet.
Dyqani shfrytezohet prej vitesh si biznes i njohur ne zone, dhe eshte nje mundesi shume e mire investimi pasi pronari aktual eshte i gatshem ta mbaje me qira ambientin ne biznesin qe ka ekzistues.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni!
title_en: Shop for sale on Rruga e Kavaje, in front of Delijorgji
description_en: Shop in St. of Kavaje - in front of Delijorgji, for sale! In one of the most favorite areas of Tirana, Ruga e Kavaje, in front of the Delijorgji complex, we offer a shop for sale. With a net surface of 222.1 m2, the store is located in the "corner", with a glass facade, offering high exposure and easy access for customers. The shop has been used for years as a well-known business in the area, and it is a very good investment opportunity since the current owner is ready to rent the premises in the existing business. For more information contact us!
